result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out. The main visual defect is in the bottom navigation bar, where a dark horizontal bar overlaps the search and bookmark icons. A few minor contrast and label concerns also exist. Clipped carousel items and the partially visible bottom card were excluded as intended features.

issues.description: A dark horizontal bar (likely the system gesture indicator) overlaps the search icon and sits on top of the bottom navigation, partly obscuring the search tab icon and making it look broken.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or safe-area inset to the bottom navigation so the system gesture bar sits below the nav icons, and keep the search icon fully visible.

issues.description: The search placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a light gray background, which gives low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the input background.

issues.description: The bottom navigation icons have no visible text labels, so the home, search, orders, and account destinations are not clear.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each bottom navigation icon.
